summary: The 916 documents are all accepted at base f45c6716 and main 88840d35; 320 misread on their LF text, classed T 83 / L 38 / S 34 / I 4 (tables: read as the engine, D3), H 75 (lazy line holding only an HTML tag: by the architect's decision the engine gets a Legion-owned html-flow that does not open kind 7 on a lazy line, Go keeps its reading, Go refuses only the tab-grammar shape, and the renderer stops writing a bare tag line, D4), F 2 (fence over a narrower whitespace line: read alike, D5), P 70 (list spread in quotes in typed blocks: read alike, D6, after D3), W 14 (INFRA-719). The footnote refusal moves to typedDefinitionRefusal with named constants and no accept/refuse change (D8). Fixtures per D9 (46 documents, 21 forms), census per D10 (INFRA-719's tools and timing, plus the engine's old-vs-new reading of stored markdown), browser test per D12.
